title: pwc-fwrestling-2011-legends
label: Shawn Hart

won.source: The Legends playoff write-up, posted 27 May 2011 ('WINNER OF THE LEGENDS: SJH').

how: Won the tie-break final over Alex Austin with a Northern Lights Suplex pin after twenty-six minutes three seconds.
note: The first major champion of The Circuit; a tournament win, so no defence or loss is held.

label: Hornet

won.source: The Prodigy Classic finals write-up, posted 30 August 2011 ('WINNER OF THE PRODIGY CLASSIC: Hornet').

how: Won the sixteen-man tournament by tapping Joey Melton out with the Scorpion Death Lock after thirty-two minutes fifty seconds at Madison Square Garden.
note: A tournament win, so no defence or loss is held.
